children: Management to host investor webcast on November 30, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET
ROCKVILLE, Md., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Quantum Space, Inc. (

) (the "Company" or "Quantum Space"), a company developing the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial missions, today announced that it will release financial results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, on Monday, November 30, 2026. Quantum Space management will also hold a webcast the same day at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the results and the Company's business outlook.

Jim Bridenstine, Chief Executive Officer of Quantum Space, and Adarsh Parekh, Chief Financial Officer of Quantum Space, will host the call to discuss the results and strategic priorities, and answer questions. The call will be webcast on the Company's investor relations website at
Following completion of the live call, an archived version of the webcast will be available on the Company's investor relations website at

) is building the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial space operations. Its highly maneuverable spacecraft are being designed to address the needs of national security and commercial operators. With patented propulsion, extended on-orbit endurance, and modular flexibility, these platforms are being engineered to outmaneuver legacy satellites and operate dynamically across diverse mission sets.
